name: S. W. Russel
role: Book-keeper of the Niobrara Cattle Co., of Miles City
bio: S. W. Russel of Miles City, book-keeper of the Niobrara Cattle Co., delivered the company's N bar cattle and returned to Miles City in early August 1885. Later that month he delivered four hundred of the company's cattle, averaging 1,298½ pounds, to the Northern Pacific Refrigerator Car Co.

moments.label: Delivered four hundred Niobrara Co. cattle

mentions: S. W. Russel, having delivered the N bar cattle, returned to Miles City, Saturday.

…g are the arrivals at the Northern Pacific hotel for the last week: Peter H. Pernot, Washington, D. C.; S. W. Russel, Miles City; H. S. Boice, Mingusville; W. H. Sewell, Elkhorn ranch; J. A. Chapman, W. Cushion, Jr., Wellington, Ohio; Wilmot Dow and wife and Mrs. Sewall, Elkhorn ranch;…
S. W. Russel, book-keeper of the Niobrara cattle Co., delivered four hundred of that Co's. cattle to the N. P. Ref. Car Co. last Thursday. They averaged 1298½ pounds.
